2607.00248.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
2607.00248.paper_summary: We present Seed2.0, a model series that takes a meaningful step toward solving complex, real-world tasks. Our approach begins with identifying users' genuine needs and constructing a reliable, forward-looking evaluation system by selecting and abstracting benchmarks grounded in these needs and in realistic, complex scenarios. Guided by this evaluation system, Seed2.0 targets two persistent challenges, long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following, substantially improving the model's reliability on intricate, long-horizon tasks. Beyond these, Seed2.0 delivers world-leading reasoning intelligence, visual understanding, and search capabilities that address the most common needs of a broad user base. Through extensive real-world use cases documented in this model card, we demonstrate that Seed2.0 begins to exhibit the ability to handle initial complex real-world tasks, delivering greater value to hundreds of millions of users.
2607.00248.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Seed2.0，一個在解決複雜現實世界任務方面邁出重要一步的模型系列。<lb/>我們的方法始於識別用戶的真實需求，並通過選擇和抽象基於這些需求和現實複雜場景的基準，構建一個可靠的前瞻性評估系統。<lb/>在這個評估系統的指導下，Seed2.0 針對兩個持久挑戰——長尾知識和複雜指令跟隨，顯著提高了模型在複雜長期任務上的可靠性。<lb/>除此之外，Seed2.0 提供世界領先的推理智能、視覺理解和搜索能力，滿足廣大用戶群體最常見的需求。<lb/>通過在這個模型卡中記錄的廣泛現實案例，我們展示了 Seed2.0 開始展現處理初步複雜現實世界任務的能力，為數億用戶提供更大的價值。
